item.title: Israeli settlers beat Palestinians and a U.S. photojournalist in West Bank attacks
item.description: Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians as they were harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank on Friday, injuring several people including a photojournalist working for The Washington Post.
item.content:encoded:
Masked Israeli settlers attacked Palestinians as they were harvesting olives in the occupied West Bank on Friday, injuring several people including a photojournalist working for The Washington Post.

item.title: Crowds throng New Delhi and wave Indian flags amid escalating protests
item.description: Protests have intensified over a review of voter lists that critics say is politically motivated and threatens to disenfranchise voters. The Election Commission and Modi's administration deny these allegations.

item.title: Sally Rooney's books will no longer be sold in U.K. after Palestinian Action support
item.description: The Irish author said her books can no longer be sold in the UK after she pledged the royalties to a banned pro-Palestinian group.

item.title: Russia's view amid Ukraine's strikes and Zelenskyy's growing rift with the U.S.
item.description: Russian authorities say Ukraine struck a major oil refinery southeast of Moscow Thursday. The strike was in response to Russia's attacks on Ukrainian energy infrastructure.

item.title: How Putin may react to the rift between the U.S. and Ukraine
item.description: Journalist and Russia analyst Julia Ioffe lays out how Vladimir Putin might be trying to exploit the current divide between the U.S. and Ukraine over striking Russian oil refineries.

item.title: Three years on, Israel still bars foreign journalists from entering Gaza
item.description: More than a year into a declared ceasefire in Gaza — and three years into the war — Israel still hasn't allowed foreign media independent access to Gaza.
item.content:encoded: More than a year into a declared ceasefire in Gaza — and three years into the war — Israel still hasn't allowed foreign media independent access to Gaza.

item.title: Social Security benefits to get a boost. And, Hasan Piker defends his rhetoric
item.description: Social Security benefits are set to get a boost to offset rising consumer prices. And, streamer Hasan Piker says the GOP's "guilt-by-association politics" won't drag Democrats down in the midterms.

item.title: Ukraine resumes attacks on Russian oil refineries, officials say, after brief truce
item.description: Ukrainian drones attacked a refinery in Russia's Ryazan region early Thursday, hours after Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said that a brief truce spurned by Moscow was over.

item.description: One plays the bull, the other the bullfighter, as a pair practices a dance of death in a sport that's prohibited in the Mexican capital city.

item.title: Ukraine says its Starshield access is back
item.description: Ukraine says its access to SpaceX's Starshield has been restored. It's the system the country uses for its offensive drone attacks on Russia.
